text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Japanese Derby drawing near.
Tokyo Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Off the 4th corner and into the straight!!
Air Groove charges through the middle!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――I won't let you get away!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Air Groove!!
In the lead is Air Groove!!
Air Groove crosses the line!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the generations, mother and daughter have woven their hopes upon the turf! It's Air Groove!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...At last, huh.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove really is on a different level...!
She utterly dominated even the Oka Sho Umamusume...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mother and daughter winning the Oaks is so touching~~!!
I'm definitely cheering for her at the Shuka Sho, too~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You did it. Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Congratulations once again!
Seriously, that was an incredible race...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you.
......However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As for me,
it feels like I've only just reached the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Having seized in my own hands the glory of the Oaks once held by my mother, my path now begins as the "Empress"—to bring the "ideal" into reality.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I will never be satisfied here. I am aiming for even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's so like you.
I can't afford to lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...... Give the 『Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)』 your best, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give it my absolute best in the greatest race ever!
—And so, the day of the Japanese Derby arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally heeeere! The clash of the Big Four!!
Man, I am so hyped for this...!!
Who's gonna win this thing...?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Anyone could take it, really.
Though personally, I'm rooting for Bubble~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...It's finally here, the 'Japanese Derby.'
choice_data_list: I'm so glad all Four Heavenly Kings are here together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder why.
Running alongside everyone in this Japan Derby...
I—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've been looking forward to this
since before I was even born.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's how excited I am right now...!
choice_data_list: That's just how special the Japanese Derby is.

text_block_list.text:
Precisely because this race is so special to both the racing world and Umamusume,
it is a stage she must challenge.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I declare it now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'll take you to the Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And without fail,
I will present you with the title of Derby Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: So――――look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm off!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Now everyone is here.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Everyone made it safely to the Japan Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that crazy!? All of them from the same foal crop gathering at the Derby...!
Bubble-chan's dad must be rolling in it!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
L-Lapis...!
Watch your mouth...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! But seriously,
I bet Dad is super happy too...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "And if a Derby Umamusume emerges from among them, that'd make me even happier, I'm sure."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And so, an announcement!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Today, I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
“......Regarding the Satsuki Sho the other day.
Everyone's running was truly magnificent.”

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
So today, I'm going to unleash it all on you.
All of this... frustration of mine.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
I will be the victor.
I'll make you all dance in my wake.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Eep~! Scary, scary!
But a terrifying Waltz-chan
is the strongest Waltz-chan, right...?! I won't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Our... once-in-a-lifetime showdown.
...On such a magnificent stage,
I shall take the victory.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin.
Our "Japanese Derby"!!
